packages.name: Base64
packages.description: Type /base64 and some text, then Tab, to encode it. /base64 -d decodes. Options set the direction and whether the result is URL-safe.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Coin Flip
packages.description: Type /coin, then Tab, to flip a coin. Options choose what it says, from heads or tails to answers of your own, and how many flips.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Compose
packages.description: Type // and a short note, then Tab. The model turns it into a message in your tone. Rename the second slash in Options.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Date
packages.description: Type /date, then Tab, for today's date. /date tomorrow or /date +7 gives another day. Options set the format, the language and what you type after the slash.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: HTML Decode
packages.description: Type /decode and some text, then Tab, to turn HTML entities such as <, ' and © back into characters.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Dice
packages.description: Type /dice, then Tab, to roll a die. /dice 20 rolls a 20-sided one and /dice 2d6 rolls two six-sided dice. Options set the dice a plain /dice rolls.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: HTML Encode
packages.description: Type /encode and some text, then Tab, to turn &, < and > into HTML entities. Options choose whether quotes and non-ASCII letters are encoded too.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Text Expander
packages.description: Type an abbreviation and press Tab: it is replaced with the text you set in Options.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Latin Letters
packages.description: Type /latin and some text, then Tab, to write it in plain Latin letters: Café becomes Cafe and İzmir becomes Izmir. An option writes a URL slug instead.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: lower case
packages.description: Type /lower and some text, then Tab, for small letters. An option follows Turkish rules, where I becomes ı.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: PascalCase
packages.description: Type /pascal and some text, then Tab, to join its words with a capital letter on each. An option starts with a small letter instead, for camelCase.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Password
packages.description: Type /password, then Tab, for a random password. /password 24 special changes one use. Options set length, characters and whether it is memorable.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Spelling & Grammar
packages.description: Underlines misspellings and grammar slips with the macOS checker, or fixes a typo when you turn that on.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Random Number
packages.description: Type /random, then Tab, for a random number in the default range. /random 200 goes up to 200, and /random 3-9 uses that range.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Rewrite Actions
packages.description: Rewrite, shorten, enrich, change tone, summarise, fix grammar, or remove filler in a selection.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: snake_case
packages.description: Type /snake and some text, then Tab, to join its words in lower case with underscores. Options change the joiner, so it can write kebab-case or CONSTANT_CASE.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Time
packages.description: Type /time, then Tab, for the time now with its time zone. /time 24 changes one use. Options set the format and whether it is UTC.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Title Case
packages.description: Type /title and some text, then Tab, to capitalise each word. Options keep small words such as of and the in lower case and leave ALL-CAPS words alone.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Translate
packages.description: Translates a selection with Hy-MT2 7B, in the same menu as your other actions.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: ALL CAPS
packages.description: Type /caps and some text, then Tab, for English capitals. /caps tr istanbul becomes İSTANBUL. A language code such as fr, de or el works the same way.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: UUID
packages.description: Type /uuid, then Tab, for a random UUID. Options set the version, the letter case, the hyphens and braces.
packages.author: Ghost Typist
